topicBlurbs.ai: Machines that learn: models, agents, research and what it all means.
topicBlurbs.programming: How software is made, and the people who make it.
topicBlurbs.infra: The machinery underneath: systems, chips, clouds and the bills that come with them.
topicBlurbs.data: Counting things carefully, and showing what the numbers say.
topicBlurbs.security: Locks, keys, and the people trying both.
topicBlurbs.tech: The industry, the platforms and the internet we live on.
topicBlurbs.design: How things look, feel and work.
topicBlurbs.product: Deciding what to build, and finding out if it worked.
topicBlurbs.startups: Building things people want, from the first users onward.
topicBlurbs.business: Companies, strategy and how markets move.
topicBlurbs.work: Jobs, teams, and doing good work for a long time.
topicBlurbs.economics: Incentives, trade-offs and how the whole system behaves.
topicBlurbs.money: Saving, investing and the stories we tell about money.
topicBlurbs.science: How the world works, and how we find out.
topicBlurbs.mind: Why we think, feel and decide the way we do.
topicBlurbs.climate: Energy, the planet and what we do next.
topicBlurbs.politics: Power, policy and how we live together.
topicBlurbs.culture: Art, film, music, games and the things we love.
topicBlurbs.writing: Words, sentences and the craft of saying things clearly.
topicBlurbs.learning: How we learn, remember and think with tools.
topicBlurbs.living: Attention, time and the rest of life.
topicBlurbs.unsorted: Not shelved yet. Gloss sorts new texts as they arrive.

add.label: Add to the library
add.title: Add articles
add.sub: Connect an agent, or paste links
add.linksBody: One or many, a line each. Gloss reads each page in and sorts it onto a topic. PDFs work too. Leaving Pocket, Instapaper or Raindrop?
add.savingNow: Saving {count} now; {rest} more wait above for the next Save.
add.fromAnyPageBody: Drag one to your bookmarks bar, then click it on any article.
add.dragMe: Drag me to your bookmarks bar
add.bookmarkTitle: Bookmark any page, then edit the bookmark
add.bookmarkBody: Paste this as its address and name it Save to Gloss.
add.agentNeedsYou: An agent saves to the library in your account, so it needs you signed in.
add.agentTitle: Let your agent shelve for you
add.agentBody: Gloss has an MCP server. Give it to Grok Bot, Claude or ChatGPT, then ask: “go through my X bookmarks from this month and save the articles to my Gloss library.” Each one is read in, sorted onto a topic, and on your shelves the next time you open Gloss.
add.made: Made. This token is shown once: copy it now.
add.couldNotMake: Could not make a connection. Try again.

setup.grokTitle: Grok Bot: say this in a chat
setup.grokBody: It asks you to confirm; then the Gloss tools are ready.
setup.claudeBody: Then ask Claude to save something to your Gloss library.
setup.claudeAiTitle: Or claude.ai: Settings, Connectors, Add custom connector
setup.claudeAiBody: This link carries your token, so keep it private.
setup.urlTitle: The server URL and a header
setup.urlOnlyTitle: Or, for apps that only take a URL, one with your token in it
setup.urlOnlyBody: Keep it private: it can end up in logs.
setup.thenAskBody: Agents save the article a post links to. When the post is the piece, like an X Article or a long post, they send its text.
